scores.notes: Viewed full size with both figures cropped: the anointed boy and the youth with the sling both have short dark curly hair, no beard, a slight build, a ragged brown tunic and a shepherd's bag on a strap. The second looks a little older, within one youth stage, so same.

Viewed full size: on the left the people walk a beach with unparted sea on one side and coastal cliffs with a clifftop town on the other; on the right the floor runs between two towering walls of water. The arrangement conflicts, the same cue as the baseline's Classical Red Sea pair.

Viewed full size: the courtyard Peter has greying hair and a grey-white beard, while the Peter stepping onto the water has black curly hair and a black beard. A hair and beard colour conflict, so different.

Viewed full size: the same wooden single-masted boat with a pale sail, crowded with disciples on the same water. The storm on the left and the calm on the right are the change Mark 4:39 describes, not a different place, so same.

Viewed full size with both faces cropped: both Peters have dark curly hair greying at the temples, a beard greying at the chin and the same lean lined face. The moonlit one only looks greyer, so no identity cue conflicts.

Viewed full size: the Peter on the water has black curly hair and a black beard, while the Peter at the shore fire has grey hair and a grey beard and looks older. A hair and beard colour conflict, so different.
